capability: Independent qualification of F-APP04 restricted PMdirect typed application composition
independence_rule: F-VQ103 may add qualification-only tests, scripts, workflow and evidence. It must not change production source, scientific equations, solver, transaction lifecycle, retry/timestep policy or the F-APP04 owner tests/gate.

scientific_denominator.rule: Do not copy or independently reimplement PMdirect equations in F-VQ103. Treat the qualified F-APP03 typed postimage as input values and qualify only transport/composition behavior.

structural: Production delta relative to subject postimage must be empty.
All three subject production blobs and all protected dependency blobs must match exactly.
No qualification code may supply PMdirect formulas or modify source files.
metamorphic_root_binding: Across a deterministic set of finite nonnegative ptra values, emerged-crop output must equal input ptra bit-for-bit while root geometry remains unchanged.
Non-emerged crop must remain canonical zero regardless of roundoff-scale positive ptra.
NaN, negative and upstream-unproduced values must fail closed.
metamorphic_surface_binding: Across deterministic finite nonnegative soil/pond demand pairs, both receiving values must equal source values bit-for-bit.
NaN, negative and upstream-unproduced values must fail closed.
metamorphic_dynamic_top_binding: Across deterministic finite nonnegative net-rain values, precipitation_rate_cm_per_day must equal source net rain bit-for-bit.
Every non-precipitation field of the base request must be bit-identical after binding.
Incoming precipitation must be non-authoritative and replaced.
NaN, negative and upstream-unproduced values must fail closed.
qualification_plan.required_identity: O0 and O2 qualification output must be byte-identical.

pass_condition: All structural, metamorphic, fail-closed and O0/O2 identity gates pass on the exact F-APP04 subject blobs without production mutation.
failure_policy: Fail closed. Do not remediate production code from the independent qualification branch. If a subject defect is found, persist the finding and hand remediation back to F-APP04.
admission_effect: F-VQ103 PASS satisfies the F-APP04 preregistration requirement for independent qualification but does not itself admit F-APP04 or close whole-Hupsel/M1-C3.
